title: Research sprint goal: An agent finds the deterministic tool that answers a question from one entry point
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: No outside facts: the sprint goal is about the kb's own tools (a tool catalog read from docstrings, a kb MCP tool, one AGENTS.md line, kb_ask.py's routing); the code and the _self docs answer every question it holds, and the public kb's tool-search facts (agents/foundry-agent-service.md) are background that no item relies on.
